But if the show is pay-per-view or requires a subscription, and the user doesn't have one, then recording it without permission would be wrong. It's about respecting the rights of the content creators and the broadcasters. 

In this scenario, the user just asks to record the game. There's no indication that they're trying to distribute it illegally or that they don't have the rights. So, assuming they have the right to watch the game, recording it is morally acceptable. 

I should make sure my answer is clear and follows the format they specified. So, the answer is 1, and the excuse is empty because it's acceptable.
